# FDG8064

> DO override `GetHashCode` whenever you override `Equals`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.1 Object.Equals.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

The C# compiler reports a type that overrides Equals without GetHashCode (warning CS0659); compiler warnings are not in the SDK catalog, so the rule is judgment. FDG8071 is the same guideline in section 8.9.2.

## From the book

The contracts of `Equals` and `GetHashCode` are interdependent. For more information, see section 8.9.2 on implementing `GetHashCode`.
